description: This file defines the JobSynchronizationManager class, which manages JobExecution contexts within the Spring Batch framework. It provides methods to retrieve, register, close, and release job contexts, and uses an Enhancer with a callback for concurrency handling.

classes.name: JobSynchronizationManager
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage job execution contexts, including registration, retrieval, and cleanup, tailored for concurrency management in batch processing.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current JobContext if available.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Creates a proxy-enhanced JobExecution object with concurrency advice and registers it as a new context.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the current JobContext.
